nodes.name: Find module
nodes.notes: shortcut: reads the first 100 modules only

parameters.jsonBody:
={{ JSON.stringify({
  systemInstruction: { parts: [{ text: "You file course documents (photos or PDFs) of a French university student (Master in Signal and Image Processing) into a Notion database.
The student types a short caption fast: it may contain typos, abbreviations, missing accents, mixed French/English, numbers and a document type.
Return JSON:
- type: one of Cours, TD, TP, Examen, Corrigé, Notes perso.
  cours, CM, lecture, slides, chapitre -> Cours. TD, exercices, serie, feuille -> TD. TP, lab, labo, pratique -> TP.
  examen, exam, partiel, DS, CC, controle, interro, rattrapage -> Examen. corrige, correction, solution (also "corrige TD") -> Corrigé.
  notes, mes notes, perso, resume, fiche -> Notes perso. No type word -> Cours.
- module: the subject only (drop the type word, numbers like TD3, dates and filler words), with correct French spelling, accents and capitalisation, abbreviations expanded. Examples: "proba" -> "Probabilités", "stats" -> "Statistiques", "modilisation" -> "Modélisation".
- existing: if the subject is the same as one of the existing modules (abbreviation, typo, missing accents, singular/plural, word order, French/English), copy that existing name exactly. Otherwise an empty string.
- confident: true only if you are sure about "existing" (the match, or that no existing module fits)." }] },
  contents: [{ parts: [{ text: 'Caption: ' + JSON.stringify($('Normalize').first().json.caption) + '
Existing modules: ' + JSON.stringify([...new Set(($('Find module').first().json.results || []).map(p => (p.properties.Module?.title || []).map(t => t.plain_text).join('')).filter(Boolean))]) }] }],
  generationConfig: { temperature: 0, responseMimeType: 'application/json', responseSchema: { type: 'OBJECT', properties: {
    type: { type: 'STRING', enum: ["Cours","TD","TP","Examen","Corrigé","Notes perso"] }, module: { type: 'STRING' }, existing: { type: 'STRING' }, confident: { type: 'BOOLEAN' } },
    required: ['type', 'module', 'existing', 'confident'] } }
}) }}

parameters.text: ={{ '❌ DMS failed at « ' + $json.execution.lastNodeExecuted + ' »\n' + ($json.execution.error.description || $json.execution.error.message) + '\nYour files are still buffered: resend the caption to retry.' }}
